user.title: Log in to AGL
user.description:
Open the URL below in your browser and log in with your AGL credentials. After login you will see a 'Not Found' page -- copy the full URL from the address bar and paste it in the field below.

`{authorize_url}`

data.callback_url: Callback URL (from address bar after login)

select_contract.title: Select contract
select_contract.description: Multiple gas contracts were found. Select the one to monitor.

reconfigure.title: Re-pin AGL certificates
reconfigure.description:
gaggle will replace its stored TLS pins with the certificates AGL is presenting now (stored → observed).

`secure.agl.com.au`: `{auth_stored}` → `{auth_observed}`

`api.platform.agl.com.au`: `{bff_stored}` → `{bff_observed}`

Only submit on a network you trust.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed or callback URL is invalid. Try opening the authorize URL again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach AGL. Check your internet connection.

abort.already_configured: This AGL contract is already configured.
abort.no_gas_contract: No gas contract was found on this AGL account. gaggle only supports gas -- for electricity, see the haggle integration.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach AGL. Check your internet connection.
abort.wrong_account: That AGL login does not include the contract this entry monitors. Log in with the original account.
